setf.rule: each reader registers exactly one setter with the canonical places implementation
setf.publication: pending registrations become visible only after successful commit
setf.rollback: an aborted library or definition publishes no pending Place rows; previously committed rows remain unchanged
setf.duplicate: same reader/same setter is idempotent; same reader/different setter is rejected

placement.resident_budget: validated minimal intern service stub only

required_gates: tag predicate positive and foreign-tag negative
copy is a distinct top-level list
setf reader mutation through the canonical places table
generated public-name collision and duplicate-slot rejection
real dialect-v2 P0 compile against the Link-68 require substrate
one L65P emitter and exact capacity currencies
first_red: resident conversion body instead of the minimal service stub
more than one new Session record
claim_limit: Host semantics and target-substrate preflight only. No target defstruct library, product link, hardware or acceptance is authorized.
